intended_object: The linear map ⨁ᵢ Mᵢ → N induced by a family of R-linear maps φᵢ : Mᵢ → N via the universal property of the direct sum (coproduct) of modules, i.e. (xᵢ) ↦ ∑ᵢ φᵢ(xᵢ). Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: The body applies DFinsupp.lsum to φ. Since ⨁ i, M i is DFinsupp, this gives the R-linear map x ↦ ∑ᵢ φᵢ(xᵢ), which is exactly the coproduct map. The ℕ argument only concerns how linear lsum is in φ, not the R-linearity of the resulting map. The setting is fully general: any semiring R, modules over additive commutative monoids, any index type ι. The [DecidableEq ι] hypothesis is the usual technical requirement for DFinsupp constructions. Degenerate cases behave correctly; for example, an empty ι gives the zero map.
